name: open-nav
description: Open source libraries and tools for the Hungarian Tax Authority (NAV) Online Számla API

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/codegen packages/core packages/client packages/invoicing packages/cli packages/mock-server packages/mcp packages/evat packages/receipt
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force packages/codegen packages/core packages/client packages/invoicing packages/cli packages/mock-server packages/mcp packages/evat packages/receipt
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm licences && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:packages
scripts.codegen: tsc -b packages/codegen && node packages/codegen/dist/main.js && prettier --write --log-level warn packages/core/src/generated packages/evat/src/generated packages/receipt/src/generated
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/core/src/generated packages/evat/src/generated packages/receipt/src/generated
